title: Tower requirements loader + join + view
user_value: Show latest-snapshot tower readiness in the app
proposed_solution: Load tower_requirements.csv, join against latest snapshot by normalized item name, and add a read-only Tower page
scope_v1: Latest snapshot only, read-only grouping and status view
dependencies: Latest snapshot storage; normalized item key; tower_requirements.csv
notes: Tower CSV loader, pure derivation, and read-only Tower page are implemented

title: Canonical item key formalization
user_value: Reduce fragile joins across mastery, tower, and future planning data
proposed_solution: Define a more explicit canonical item identity contract and migration path beyond normalized names
scope_v1: Documented key strategy and minimal compatibility helpers
dependencies: Current normalized item key flow; reference CSV loaders
notes: Do not force ID migration until data sources are ready

title: Tower data validation
user_value: Catch malformed or inconsistent tower rows before they confuse planning views
proposed_solution: Add validation checks for tower CSV schema, duplicate rows, unsupported mastery tiers, and suspicious blanks
scope_v1: Loader-level validation report or tests for known bad shapes
notes: Tower CSV already encodes GM/MM correctly and should stay source of truth

title: Unmatched reference data polish
user_value: Make missing reference matches easier to understand and maintain
proposed_solution: Improve messaging, counts, and export/report affordances for unmatched mastery and tower rows
scope_v1: Display polish and small workflow helpers only
notes: Do not make missing matches fatal

title: Reference CSV schema validation
user_value: prevent silent errors in CSV reference files and improve confidence in data integrity
proposed_solution: add runtime validators for app reference CSV schemas and surface clear non-fatal validation failures where appropriate
scope_v1: validate mastery_difficulty.csv and tower_requirements.csv shape and required fields in their loaders
notes: planning/backlog.csv itself does not need app-style runtime validation unless later tooling requires it

title: Tower accordion / collapse completed levels
user_value: reduce noise from completed tower levels and make the next relevant mastery targets easier to spot
proposed_solution: add collapsible tower sections with an option to collapse or hide fully completed levels
scope_v1: accordion UI for tower levels with completed levels collapsed by default or hideable, while incomplete levels remain expanded
dependencies: Tower page; grouped tower derivation output
notes: prefer level-based collapse before range-based collapse; avoid derivation changes unless lightweight completed-level summaries are needed. Future nice-to-haves: jump to first incomplete level; sticky next relevant level summary; auto-expand only the first incomplete level; sort incomplete levels above completed ones.

title: Detect collapsed mastery export sections
user_value: prevent incomplete mastery imports caused by collapsed export sections
proposed_solution: detect missing mastery tiers during import and show warning with override
scope_v1: warn when expected mastery tiers are missing or the parsed row count is suspiciously small, but still allow import anyway
dependencies: Import page validation layer; parsed row tier analysis
notes: Shipped with non-fatal warning and override. False-positive Tier II warning caused by threshold mismatch was fixed so validation now uses parsed tier thresholds consistently.

title: Tower filters and summaries
user_value: Help users inspect tower requirements faster
proposed_solution: Add simple filters, grouped summaries, and quick status slices on the Tower page
scope_v1: Read-only filters and summary cards
notes: Keep first tower release minimal before adding richer controls

title: Snapshot comparison view
user_value: Show progress between two saved mastery snapshots
proposed_solution: Build a local-only snapshot diff view for item mastery changes and summary deltas
scope_v1: Compare two local snapshots without backend
notes: Avoid widening into full history management at the same time

title: Import validation report
user_value: Help users understand parse anomalies before saving
proposed_solution: Add a clearer import report for skipped lines, duplicate rows, and suspicious parsing outcomes
scope_v1: Read-only validation summary on import flow
notes: Should reuse parser outputs rather than duplicate parsing logic

title: Mastery export instructions page + import help link
user_value: Help users correctly export mastery data from FarmRPG and avoid incomplete imports caused by collapsed accordion sections.
proposed_solution: Create a simple help page with screenshots and step-by-step instructions showing how to export mastery data correctly. Add a "How do I export mastery data?" link on the import screen that opens this help page.
scope_v1: New help page explaining mastery export steps; Step-by-step instructions: 1. Open the Item Mastery page 2. Expand ALL tiers (Tier V, Tier IV, Tier III, Tier II, No Tier) 3. Select and copy the mastery list 4. Paste into the import box; Include example screenshots: Correct export (all tiers expanded) and Incorrect export (collapsed tiers); Add contextual link on the import screen: "How do I export mastery data?"; Link opens the help page
notes: The mastery page uses collapsible tier sections, which can cause incomplete exports if tiers are collapsed. This documentation should reduce user error and complement the collapsed-tier import warning added in v1.5.2.

title: Export unmatched tower rows
user_value: Make tower reference maintenance easier
proposed_solution: Export tower rows missing local matches as CSV templates for manual cleanup
scope_v1: CSV export only; no in-app editing
notes: Mirror unmatched mastery export philosophy

title: Item alias support
user_value: Improve joins when item naming differs across exports and CSVs
proposed_solution: Add alias mapping support layered on top of normalized names
scope_v1: Alias lookup file and join fallback only
notes: Useful before heavier planning features

title: Item registry file
user_value: Centralize cross-source item metadata in one place
proposed_solution: Create a local registry that can map canonical key, aliases, FarmRPG IDs, buddy IDs, and slugs
scope_v1: Schema and loader only at first
notes: Likely foundation for later recipes and buddy enrichment

title: Buddy slug enrichment
user_value: Improve linkage to buddy-oriented data and exports
proposed_solution: Backfill buddy_slug across local reference datasets where known
scope_v1: Data enrichment without making buddy slug canonical
notes: Keep optional and non-blocking

title: Buddy slug acquisition workflow
user_value: Create a repeatable way to capture missing buddy slugs
proposed_solution: Document or script a local workflow for collecting and reviewing buddy slug gaps
scope_v1: Workflow notes or helper export only
notes: No sync or external automation yet

title: Recipe graph schema
user_value: Prepare clean foundations for recipe-aware planning
proposed_solution: Define local schema for recipe inputs, outputs, and dependency relationships
scope_v1: Schema and sample loader only
dependencies: Item registry direction; future recipe data
notes: Keep out of current mastery-only milestones

title: Recipe-based planning MVP
user_value: Use recipe relationships to support actionable planning
proposed_solution: Build a small MVP that surfaces recipe dependencies for selected goals
scope_v1: Local-only planning prototype
notes: Do not start before tower and item identity stabilize

title: Spreadsheet replacement planning views
user_value: Replace manual spreadsheet workflows with focused in-app views
proposed_solution: Add read-only planning pages that combine mastery, tower, and future recipe/reference data
scope_v1: Small targeted planning views rather than one giant dashboard
dependencies: Tower support; recipe foundations; item identity improvements
notes: Should stay milestone-driven and local-first

title: Community feature request intake
user_value: Track external requests in a structured way
proposed_solution: Create a lightweight intake format for community feature ideas and pain points
scope_v1: Documentation/process only
notes: No public workflow needed yet

title: Community voting workflow
user_value: Prioritize community-driven improvements transparently later
proposed_solution: Define a simple voting or ranking process for community requests
scope_v1: Process design only
notes: Not needed until feature intake exists
